messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] How to enable autokill?
parts:
autokill *only* kills the job if there are R errors. Since it's tricky to know whicj hadoop error is actually unrecoverable
i havent inserted any logic - i.e. node failure is not necessarily the end of the job. Rather you can insert custom handlers to decide your own rules
look at rhstatus and write your own handler.
